Class FloridianToothRecord

java.lang.Object
FloridianToothRecord
public class FloridianToothRecord extends Object
Program FloridianToothRecord Records the teeth of the members of one Florida family. The user enters the number of people in the family (max = 6), then each person's name and a string of tooth types for their uppers and for their lowers (max = 8 teeth each). Each tooth is an incisor ('I'), bicuspid ('B'), or missing tooth ('M'). The names are stored in an array of strings, and the teeth in a 3D array of characters: one plane per person, two rows (uppers and lowers), and one column per tooth. A menu then lets the user print the family's teeth record, extract a tooth, report the family's root canal indices (the roots of the quadratic Ix^2 + Bx - M), or exit.
